about: Tattoo designs Forge can add to a derived look, only on skin the finished outfit leaves visible (docs/BODY_ART_PLAN.md). Vector designs are paths authored in this repository (designs/*.json, Apache-2.0), rasterised by wardrobe/body_art/raster.py. A raster design (source: raster) is a PNG installed only by tools/body_art/install_design.py, with its licence and origin in designs/<id>.provenance.json beside it.

designs.name: Tribal Wings
designs.description: Symmetrical winged tribal across the shoulder blades, narrowing to the spine.

designs.name: Thorn Filigree
designs.description: A central diamond with thorned curls to each shoulder blade.

designs.name: V Tribal

designs.name: Spine Tribal

designs.name: Geometric Bands

designs.name: Lace Ornament
